comment: major reconstruction and acceptable revised scope
new_evidence: Clean-room V20-V31 evidence chain and two explicit scopes.
original_weakness: Old dual-method evidence was not independently reproducible.
proposed_manuscript_change: Replace old method/results with the selected evidence-aligned scope after AE guidance.
response_wording: We completed a clean-room reconstruction and seek guidance on whether the audit-centric scope remains suitable as a major revision.

new_evidence: EEGDfus, STANDARD, strong population DET, matched DET and subject-agnostic diffusion are included.
proposed_manuscript_change: Add common-panel absolute tables and distinguish matched from strongest baseline.
response_wording: We added strong deterministic and diffusion controls and report absolute, not only relative, outcomes.

new_evidence: V26 PopSDEdit and V28/V29 population diffusion routes.
response_wording: We now compare support-aware diffusion with frozen subject-agnostic diffusion under matched data and sampling.

new_evidence: V30 common panel reports RAW/STANDARD references.
proposed_manuscript_change: Expose observation and conventional preprocessing references.
response_wording: RAW/STANDARD references are now separated from learned methods.
The expanded controls show mixed, not established, correct-context specificity.

original_weakness: Window-level evidence overstated biological sample size.
proposed_manuscript_change: Describe participants as biological units and windows/seeds as repeated measurements.
response_wording: We replaced window-level interpretation with participant-first summaries.

proposed_manuscript_change: Replace superseded V30 duration curve with V31 exact contract.
response_wording: We corrected overlap and future-normalization errors and report acquisition and effective exposure separately.
We report sampler-step sensitivity and fixed-hardware latency/memory.

new_evidence: V30 context/projector linkage top-1 and AUROC.
original_weakness: Subject state may act as an identifier.
proposed_manuscript_change: Add linkage-risk audit and storage size; withdraw anonymity language.
response_wording: The states are strongly linkable in development data; we do not claim privacy safety.

new_evidence: Strict query-disjoint early support and EEG-only later query inference.
original_weakness: Target data usage and deployment setting were unclear.
proposed_manuscript_change: Reframe as within-session query-disjoint calibration and state its limitation.
response_wording: We use only a disjoint support bank at inference and make no cross-session claim.

new_evidence: Natural SGE development complements paired data, but sealed and new montage remain unopened.
proposed_manuscript_change: Withdraw cross-montage/generalization claim and ask AE whether this is acceptable.
response_wording: We cannot support cross-montage generalization and explicitly withdraw it.

new_evidence: Observation retention, PSD and covariance are reported; ERP/SSVEP/ERD endpoints unavailable.
original_weakness: Artifact attenuation alone cannot establish preservation.
proposed_manuscript_change: Remove proxy aliases and state N/A.
response_wording: Task-valid physiological preservation is unavailable and is not claimed.
